description: Which honua-sdk-js markdown is part of the Open Knowledge Format bundle. Consumed by scripts/check-okf-bundle.py.

spec.name: Open Knowledge Format
spec.note: One markdown file is one concept; the file path is the concept's identity; relative markdown links are the graph edges. `type` is the only required frontmatter field.

workstream: WS9 — the other nine repositories. honua-sdk-js is last and largest, deliberately: 137 pages, and the least settled structure, so typing it earlier would have been rework.

conceptTypes.index: A section entry point. Enumerates what the directory holds so a reader or agent can choose before opening.
conceptTypes.concept: What a thing is and how it fits. No procedure.
conceptTypes.guide: A task someone performs, start to finish.
conceptTypes.reference: Lookup material: surfaces, options, contracts, matrices.

excludedDirs.why: Decision records and execution plans - scope splits, library selections, market strategy, 1.0 sequencing. They explain why the SDK is shaped as it is, for people changing it rather than people using it.

rejectedFields.timestamp: Not an OKF field in any version. The trust family spells the build stamp `generated`.

boundaryNote: The inverse of honua-console: here most of docs/ really is product documentation, so 102 of 137 pages are in. What is out divides into three kinds - decision records and execution plans, generated artifacts that are regenerated rather than maintained, and CI apparatus describing this repository's own lanes and corpora. Descriptions on the eight on-ramp pages are written; the long tail is extracted from each page's own opening sentence, which is real prose rather than a title echo but is a first pass to refine.
